rows.label: tlk70000089_02_msg0001
rows.name:
As expected of His Majesty, Emperor
of Superbia. Winning people's hearts
is second nature.

rows.label: tlk70000089_02_msg0002
rows.name:
What? It's not from government
business, but from interacting
with so many different people?

rows.label: tlk70000089_02_msg0003
rows.name:
Hmm, I see... That's something we in
Gula need to learn from.

rows.label: tlk70000089_02_msg0004
rows.name:
It's not possible to gain
the people's trust just by
dishing out orders...

rows.label: tlk70000089_02_msg0005
rows.name:
Because you speak with people as
equals, the people of Iira and Gula
have come to trust you all.
